messages:
anya: Packaging alert: offline-installer v1.8.0-rc2 uploaded to mirror with a different digest than CI produced. Thinking we should hold the night canary.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: private-vpc/installer v1.8.0-rc2 -> staging-canary @ 2026-03-23T22:00Z. Tag: rc2-staging. To pause: /hold. To roll back: /rollback 1.8.0-rc1.

sam: Where's the mismatch coming from? md5 vs sha256? gzip mismatch?

anya: Quick dump from my laptop:

```
$ sha256sum offline-installer-v1.8.0-rc2.tar.gz
expected: c0ffeec0bebaf00d9a7f...\nfound: d34db33f2a7a...\n
```

maria: Could be mirror caching or an interrupted re-sign step.

lee: ops-oncall, can you check cosign sig timestamps and signer key used for the package?

ops-oncall: On it. Initial check: one package chunk's cosign sig timestamp is older than the current signer rotation (rotated 2026-02-28). Digging CI and mirror logs.

anya: Root cause: packaging job picked up a cached tar from mirror that had been produced before the signer rotation. CI rebuilt and re-signed, but mirror didn't refresh so uploaded artifact diverged.

sam: Proposal: hold the canary, re-run the packager using the live signer, refresh shrinkwrap, verify checksums, re-sign, then reschedule. Agree?

maria: Yes. Also update release notes to explain the delay (key rotation + mirror refresh) so customers aren't surprised.

deploy-bot: Deploy held. Canaries paused. Suggested commands in runbook: `./scripts/packager/rebuild.sh --no-cache --signer=live && ./scripts/packager/verify.sh && cosign sign <artifact>` then `deploy-bot /schedule 22:45Z` to attempt again.

anya: Rebuilding now and will open a PR to pin the packager's signer version to avoid mid-delivery flips.

ops-oncall: Mirror republish in progress. ETA ~25m. Will post final sha256 and cosign verification when complete.

lee: Rollback criteria still: >1% client checksum failures during canary or any cosign signature mismatch. Also abort on >20% latency regression for API serving.

sam: Also let's use a unique artifact tag like `rc2-20260323-signed` to prevent ambiguous tags if we reupload.

maria: I'll prep a short blurb for release notes and update canary checklist. Ping when reschedule time is set.

anya: New sha256 after rebuild: `sha256: c0ffeec0bebaf00d9a7f...` Uploaded and mirrors refreshed.

ops-oncall: Cosign verify OK on all shards. Mirror checksums consistent. Reschedule window proposed: 22:50Z. deploy-bot will wait 5m for objections.

lee: Reschedule looks good. Please add a one-liner postmortem to the release notes about the hold and the packager pin.

sam: ACTIONS: anya -> PR to pin signer + repack, ops-oncall -> republish + cosign verify, maria -> release notes + checklist updates, sam -> monitor canary metrics.

anya: Done. PR opened: packager:pin-signer-20260323. Will watch the canary once live.

deploy-bot: Deploy rescheduled: private-vpc/installer v1.8.0-rc2 -> staging-canary @ 2026-03-23T22:50Z (tag rc2-20260323-signed). Good luck! :rocket:
